## Exercise 1 — Import and inspect

**Goal:** Read the tornado data and report its size.

```{r import-tornado, eval = FALSE}
# read tornado data
tornado_data <- read_csv("data/tornado-path.csv")
glimpse(tornado_data)
```

> There are 16000 rows and 19 variables.

## Exercise 2 — Select and overwrite

**Goal:** Keep only the columns needed for later steps.

```{r select-overwrite, eval = FALSE}
# read tornado data
tornado_data <- read_csv("data/tornado-path.csv") %>%

# select storm date and time, state, magnitude, fatalities, length, and width. remove the rest.
  select(storm_date, storm_time, state_name, magnitude, fatality_count, length, width)
```
